EXACT_DUPLICATE.description: Authoritative canonical text is identical after the repository's strict normalization.

NEAR_DUPLICATE.description: The same entity, scope, time, claim, and value are expressed with materially different wording.

VERSION_UPDATE.description: A compatible successor extends or explicitly supersedes prior information without an overlapping contradiction.

TEMPORAL_VARIANT.description: Comparable claims apply to explicit non-overlapping time periods.

CONDITIONAL_VARIANT.description: The broad subject is shared but a material qualifier differs, such as market, trim, protocol, price type, or price basis.

TEMPLATE_VARIANT.description: Text or table structure is strongly shared while entity or business identity intentionally differs.

CONFLICT.description: Aligned claims have compatible entity, business, qualifier, and temporal scope but incompatible values or polarity.

DISTINCT.description: The pair is not a duplicate, version, temporal/conditional/template variant, or aligned conflict.

UNCERTAIN.description: Available extraction or context is insufficient for a safe deterministic relation.

mapping_notes: Structured 'unchanged' is claim equivalence, not proof of byte- or chunk-level exact duplication.
The generic text classifier has no native CONDITIONAL_VARIANT or UNCERTAIN output; those labels are expected to expose current coverage gaps.
Repository candidates remain reviewable unless an independent strict-identity auto-reuse gate applies.

p2_failure_taxonomy.ENTITY_MENTION_MISS: No entity mention was recovered from claim or inherited context.
p2_failure_taxonomy.ENTITY_ALIAS_MISS: An entity mention was found but did not resolve through a versioned registry alias.
p2_failure_taxonomy.ENTITY_FALSE_MERGE: Two different business entities were assigned the same canonical identifier.
p2_failure_taxonomy.ENTITY_AMBIGUOUS: An alias maps to multiple canonical entities and resolution abstained.
p2_failure_taxonomy.PRODUCT_SCOPE_ERROR: A material Vinhomes product or hierarchy facet was missing or incorrect.
p2_failure_taxonomy.COMMERCIAL_SCOPE_ERROR: Price type, basis, channel, or inclusion qualifier was missing or incorrect.
p2_failure_taxonomy.VEHICLE_SCOPE_ERROR: A material VinFast model, trim, year, market, protocol, battery, drivetrain, or charging facet was missing or incorrect.
p2_failure_taxonomy.TEMPORAL_SCOPE_ERROR: Reference, validity, publication, event, or multi-period context was missing or incorrect.
p2_failure_taxonomy.QUALIFIER_SCOPE_ERROR: A stable versus optional qualifier was missing, promoted, or compared incorrectly.
p2_failure_taxonomy.CONTEXT_INHERITANCE_ERROR: A facet was inherited from an unverified source or failed to inherit from an allowed source.
p2_failure_taxonomy.NUMERIC_IDENTIFIER_ERROR: A business identifier was treated as a semantic quantity, or a semantic quantity was suppressed as an identifier.
